test_title: PYST 56: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. H is sitting to the immediate right of C. B sitting third to the left of H. P is not an immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting on the immediate right of H?
solution:
**Given:** Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) H is sitting to the immediate right of C.

2) B sitting third to the left of H.
